blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Accounting is the language of Czarnikow's numbers. Today's lesson is about Accounts Receivable. It gives you short, simple sentences you can use with the finance team.

You will learn five useful words: client, receivable, due, remind, and statement. Then you will practise them in short, natural sentences with the modal verb "can".

Go slowly — one step at a time. English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts. You can do it!

items.q: What is today's lesson about?
items.why: "Today's lesson is about Accounts Receivable."

items.q: How many new words will you learn?
items.why: "You will learn five useful words."

items.q: Which modal verb will you practise?
items.why: "practise them... with the modal verb 'can'."

items.q: The sentence "Go slowly — one step at a time" suggests that…
options: you do not need to hurry
items.why: Inferência: "go slowly" e "one step at a time" mostram que não há pressa.

items.q: "English comes in CAN's, not in CAN'Ts." The author most likely wants you to feel…
items.why: Inferência: a frase e "You can do it!" passam confiança ao aluno.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Sophie apresentar o tema a um novo estagiário. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Hi! Welcome to the accounting team. My name is Sophie. I am happy to help you today. Do not worry — the work is easy when we go slowly.

Our team is small, but we are very organised. This week we work with Accounts Receivable. It is money that clients have to pay us. Every client is on this list.

Look here. This is a new client. And here is the amount that is due. "Due" means the day to pay. Can you see the date? Good. Very good.

Every day, we check the numbers. We check them one by one. At the end of the day, we send a statement to the client. A statement shows all the numbers on one page. Then we remind the client to pay. To remind is to help them not forget the date.

Now you try. Can you read the first client's name for me? Take your time. One step at a time. You can do it! And remember — if you have a question, you can ask me. I am here to help you every day.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is Sophie's job?
options: She is on the accounting team
She is on the sales team
items.why: "Welcome to the accounting team. My name is Sophie."

items.q: What is Accounts Receivable, in Sophie's words?
options: Money that clients have to pay us
items.why: "It is money that clients have to pay us."

items.q: What does "due" mean?
items.why: "'Due' means the day to pay."

items.q: How does Sophie treat the new trainee?
items.why: Inferência: "Take your time", "You can do it!" e "I am here to help" mostram paciência.

items.q: Why does the team send a statement?
options: To show all the numbers to the client
items.why: Inferência: "A statement shows all the numbers" e depois lembram o cliente de pagar.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The client has to pay us this week." A client is…
items.why: Client = cliente, quem compra e paga.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "There is a new ___ to review — money a client still has to pay."
items.why: Receivable = a receber, o valor que o cliente ainda deve.

items.q: "The payment is due on Friday." Due means…
items.why: Due = devido / dia de vencimento.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Can you ___ the client to pay? They may forget."
items.why: Remind = lembrar alguém de algo.

items.q: "Please send the statement to the client." A statement is…
options: a paper that shows all the numbers
items.why: Statement = extrato, o documento com todos os números.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no dia a dia do time financeiro. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "Can you fill in this form, please?" To fill in means to…
items.why: Fill in = preencher (escrever as respostas).

items.q: "Please hand in the statement to Sophie." To hand in means to…
items.why: Hand in = entregar algo a alguém.

items.q: "I will follow up with the client tomorrow." To follow up means to…
items.why: Follow up = dar continuidade, verificar de novo depois.

items.q: "The manager has to sign off on the payment." To sign off on means to…
items.why: Sign off on = aprovar formalmente.

items.q: "Can you check on the due date for me?" To check on means to…
options: look at it to be sure
items.why: Check on = verificar algo para ter certeza.
